test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

One must __brush up on__ entire course before the day of examination.
solution:
The correct answer is **'No substitution'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **'brush up on' **is best suited for the given sentence.
 
• The meaning of the idiom **'brush up on'** is practicing and enhancing your abilities or your understanding of anything you previously learned.
 
• For example: 
 
 
• ​Brush up on your grammar before writing the speech.
 
 

** Hence, the correct answer is:** **No substitution** is needed.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us look at the meanings of other words:
 
 
• **Brush about: **meaningless.
 
• **Brushing on: **meaningless.
 
• **Brushing off: **to disregard or neglect someone.
